name: ai-interview-preparation-platform-backend
description: Backend API for the AI Interview Preparation Platform for Engineering Students

scripts.clean: node -e "import('node:fs').then(({ rmSync }) => rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }))"
scripts.db:types:check: supabase gen types typescript --local > .temp.database.types.ts && node -e "if(require('fs').readFileSync('src/persistence/database.types.ts', 'utf8') !== require('fs').readFileSync('.temp.database.types.ts', 'utf8')) { console.error('Database types are out of sync. Run npm run db:types:generate'); process.exit(1); }" && node -e "require('fs').unlinkSync('.temp.database.types.ts')"
scripts.db:validate: npm run db:lint && npm run db:test && npm run db:types:check
scripts.validate:app: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run openapi:check && npm test && npm run build
scripts.validate:phase2: npm run db:reset && npm run db:types:check && npm run db:validate && npm run test:e2e:phase2 && npm run validate:app
scripts.validate: npm run db:validate && npm run validate:app
